about: The short points on a number's meaning page, written by a Claude session from the course text: the course's own words, shortened, nothing added. Key = chart.position:number, or chart.position:number+partner for a center's circle. Each group is a heading and its points; sources = the knowledge/raw files the points were taken from. **Double stars** mark the words that should stand out (shown bold). The full course words stay one tap away on the page. Owner's ask 2026-10-19 (test page: Allison Frank's mind center 7 with 13/4). Rules (owner 2026-10-19): short fragments, not sentences; bold the words that matter; leave out sentences about the POSITION itself ("part of your brand" is the mind center, not the 7), referrals to a numerologist, tarot descriptions, and pairs with other numbers (those go under the pair's own key). A hand-written set may carry "cites" beside "points" (one per point, { book, page } or null): the page of the course PDF (knowledge/books.json) the point was shortened from; shown on the point (2026-10-21, the nine dharma lines of the Essence book p. 47). "more" maps a page key to a second set shown after the page's own points (the Diamond Method's path to integration on the day pages, the Name Change 5 Steps booklet's rules on the sub-chart pages; owner 2026-10-21).
